title: Renumber SII objects for ES
summary: Renumbers the SII table extensions, page extensions and codeunits in the Spanish (ES) Base Application layer. These cover payment methods, VAT clauses, VAT posting setup, journal lines, role center cues and activities, and sales and purchase documents and history.
key_points: SII objects in the ES Base Application layer get new object IDs, mostly in the 7000100 to 7000151 range
Covers table extensions, page extensions and codeunits across bank, VAT, finance role centers, purchases and sales
Includes the SII purchase, sales and VAT subscriber codeunits and the data classification codeunit
Each file has only a small edit, and no new functionality is described
Linked to work item AB#653192, with no tests added
